en: A vintage, black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard. The large upper image shows a forest holiday house with a steep tiled roof, surrounded by thin pine trees; several women and a child stand in front. The lower left image shows a group of well‑dressed people standing on a narrow bridge or plank over a pond in a forest. The lower right image shows a quiet forest pond bordered by trees. German captions identify the holiday house of the city of Görlitz in Rauscha and views from the Görlitzer Heide at Ziebelteich.
